title: Mini Daisies with Border
description: This mini original has a big impact. The textures and florals combine with a hand-painted border, creating an intricate piece that's perfect for gifting, or for adding to a little shelf arrangement.

images.alt: Mini Daisies by Calico Melton: white daisies in a pink vase on a dark green ground with a red and white painted border, in a green frame, beside a candle.
